summary_en: Ureru Net Advertising Group entered into a basic agreement to acquire 100% of Light Inc., an AI service development and operations company with operating profit and projected revenue up to ¥250 million. Acquisition structure and terms to be finalized.
title_en: Basic Agreement Executed for Full Subsidiary Acquisition of Light Inc., an 'AI Service Development and Operations Company' Generating Operating Profit with Maximum Revenue of ¥250 Million (Supplementary Explanation Materials)
translation_en_brief: Ureru Net Advertising Group Co., Ltd. has executed a basic agreement to acquire 100% of Light Inc., an AI service development and operations company. Light Inc. is described as profitable on an operating-profit basis with projected maximum annual revenue of ¥250 million. The disclosure indicates this is a full subsidiary acquisition (完全子会社化), bringing Light Inc. under Ureru's full operational control. The announcement is accompanied by supplementary explanation materials and a video presentation by the target company's CEO. Specific transaction terms, valuation, and settlement timeline are to be determined in definitive documentation.
